note: Family-run campground with a farmhouse and cabin rentals on Rt. 205, 4 mi from Presque Isle, above the Aroostook River valley; pool, canoe and kayak rentals with shuttle, ATV and bike trails from the sites. Sells seasonal leases as well as nights. --Claude
summary: Sites 75->54; added 50 amp, W/S, May 15-Oct 15, Campspot. Fee $61-71 worked from the operator's own season figures. Likely over the gate and seasonal-heavy: see flags. Note's 'on the bank' removed.
flags: GATE, DROP CANDIDATE: operator's own season comparison works out to ~$61 (30A) and ~$71 (50A) before tax. No gateway within 40 km (Kouchibouguac 230 km). Not a Good Sam Park (directory false, ratings 0). RV Life tier is $$$ (avg $41; stored tier 2 is stale). 2026 campers on RV Life: $49 (7/2026, travel trailer, site 70, W/E/S), $55 (9/2026), $65 (5/2026, motorhome, site 50, pull-through, W/E/S), $65 (5/2026), $80 (8/2026, site 71). So there may be a cheaper type under $50, as the $49 shows; 'options of different hookups and prices' (RV Life). Campspot's availability answer gave no site types for 6/15 or 7/13/2027 or 5/19/2026, so no quote was read. The $49 is the only support for passing.

LONG-STAY: operator pitches the season hard. 'Ask About Seasonal'; '30 Amp Full Hookup — Seasonal $4,500'; 'Most Popular 50 Amp Full Hookup — Seasonal $5,000'; 'it's your home base in the north'; 'dust-free roads matter to the people who live here'. It also says 'Daily, Weekly & Monthly Available' and 'Online reservations now live — first time in 32 years'. Imagery shows ~50 rigs in tight rows on the east loops, which fits many seasonals; I can't count them. Nights are sold to the public, so it isn't out on that test. How many of the 54 are open nightly is unread.

REVIEWS: Google 4.6/97; RV Life 46 reviews, 4.5 stored; Good Sam 0. Quoted, Google: 'Very friendly family owned RV Park with a great view of across the river. Very quiet. Can be a little challenging for 45ft class A Motorcoach with narrow roads and low hanging branches.'; 'The RV sites offered amazing views'. RV Life 5/2026: 'Views were amazing as was the sunset.'

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. RV loops sit ~450-700 m east of the Aroostook River, across Rt. 205 and open fields. Note's 'On the bank of the Aroostook River' was wrong and is gone. Farmhouse 'porch overlooking the river valley' is the operator's phrase. A reviewer's 'great view of across the river' is distant at best, and imagery shows a low rise with fields; nothing suggests a water view from a pad.
PIN OK: stored 46.72215,-67.95035 is at the office and pool; rig centroid ~46.7230,-67.9478 is ~215 m NE. Within tolerance.
